content: Taabotaza Di7eteth
He wode Isra7eele asay Filisxeeme asaa olanaas kezides; Isra7eele asay Aben7eezeren,
Filisxeeme asay Afeeqen dunkaanides.
Filisxeeme asay Isra7eele asaa olanaas ba olanchchata salfisides; olazi keehi minniin Isra7eele asay Filisxeeme asaan xoonettides. He olaan 4,000 gidana asi Isra7eeleppe hayqqides.

Ola asay ba guta guta simmida wode Isra7eele halaqati, «GODAY hach nuni Filisxeemetan xoonettana mala aazas ooththidee? Nunara issife kezidi nu morkketa kusheppe nuna ashshana mala GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa ane Seeloppe ekki yoos» gida.

Hessa gishshas derezi gede Seelo as kiittidi, kirube giddon ba araata bolla uttida GODAA Ubbaafe Wolqqama Xoossaa Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa ehisida. Eele naa nam7ati Afineynne Finihaasi Caaqo Qaala Taabotara heen deettes.
GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotay gede Isra7eele olanchchati dunkaani dizaso bi gelida mala biittay qaaxxanaashe gakkanaas Isra7eele asay ubbay ufayssan wolqqama waaso waassides.
Filisxeeme asay hessa wolqqama waasoza siyidi, «Hayssi Isra7eele asay dizason nu siyiza wolqqama waasoy ay waasoo?» gi oychchida; GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotay hee yidayssa eridi,
Filisxeeme asay babbidi, «Xoossi istta guta yida gishshas nuus aayye ana! Hayssa malay nunara gaytti erenna.
Nuus aayye ana! Hayta wolqqama eeqa xoossata kusheppe nuna ashshanay oonee? Hayti kase Gibxe asaa bazzo biittan dumma dumma boshan shocida eeqa xoossata.
Filisxeeme asawu, minnite! Intte addeteththi eretto! Histtontta aggiko intte kase istta ayllesida mala Ibraawe asay inttena ayllesana; intte addeteththi eretto, olettite!» gida.
Histtiin Filisxeeme asay olettides; Isra7eele asay xoonettidi issoy issoy baqati ba dunkaanen gelides; daro asay wurides; Isra7eeleppe 30,000 olanchchati hayqqida.
Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotaykka di7ettides; Eele naa nam7ati Afineynne Finihaasi hayqqida.
Eele Hayqo
He gallas issi Biniyaame dere asi ba may7o daakkidi ba hu7e bolla gudulla laallidi olasoppe woththan Seelo yides.

Addezi hee gakkida mala Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa gishshas ba wozinan ceecishe diza Eeley oge achchan ba oyde bolla uttidi naage bolla dees; addezikka gede katamaa gelidi hanida ubbaa yootiin asay siyidi katamaa waason qaaththides.
Eeleykka waasoza siyidi, «Hessi aaza waasoo?» gi oychchides; addezi eeson yiidi Eeles yootides.
He wode Eeles layththay 98 gidida gishshas iza ayfeti xeellanaas dandaybeettenna.
Addezi Eeles, «Tani ha7i olasoppe yuus yays; hach olappe kessa ekka yadis» gides. Eeleykka, «Ta naazoo! Histtiin aazee waaniday?» gi oychchides.

Woreza ehida addezi, «Isra7eele asay Filisxeeme asaa sinththafe baqatides; ola asaappe daroy wurides; hessaththoka ne naa nam7ati Afineynne Finihaasi hayqqida; Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotay di7ettides» gides.

Addezi Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa gishshas yootida mala, Eeley gimbe penge achchan uttida oydeza bollafe zokko bolla kundides; izi ceega gidida gishshassinne izas gubbay deexo gidida gishshas qoodheppe meqqi hayqqides; izi Isra7eele asaa bolla 40 layth pirdides.
Finihaase Machchi Hayqo

He wode iza naaza Finihaase machcha shaarara dawus; iza yelanaas wodey wurides; iza Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotay di7ettidayssa, izi azina aaway hayqqidayssanne ba azina hayqokka siyida mala miixay minniin gulbata yeladus.
Iza shemppo kezana hanishin izi achchan diza maccassati, «Aykkoy ba; attuma naa yeladasa» gida; iza gidikko zaaro immabeekku; ezga siyabeekku.
Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotay di7ettida gishshas izi azinaynne azinaza aaway hayqqida gishshas, «Bonchchoy Isra7eeleppe shaakettides» gashe naaza, «Ikaboode»
ga sunththadus.
Qasseka, «Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotay di7ettida gishshas bonchchoy Isra7eeleppe shaakettides» gadus.

footnotes.text: Ikaboode guussi Ibraaweta qaalara Xoossa bonchchoy dendides woykko dhaydes guussa.
